name: file-preview
title: File preview
description: A composable file previewer that delegates each file type to a renderer registry: images through a script-inert img element with loading and error states, PDFs through the browser's built-in viewer with a download fallback, and unknown kinds through a fallback surface. Consumers extend or override renderers per kind without library changes.
